widget.name: Deal Distribution
widget.description: The widget automatically assigns the responsible manager to incoming deals using a chosen strategy: round-robin, by load (fewest open deals) or by rules (source, pipeline, budget, tag → manager). It respects a manager pool and selected pipelines, can skip absent managers and reassign a deal if the manager doesn't pick it up in time (SLA). Rules are configured on a dedicated page; the deal card shows who it was assigned to and why.

settings.api_token: Backend access key (X-Security-Key header; equals API_SECURITY_KEY on the server)

notify.need_https: Backend URL must start with https://

card.title: Distribution
card.not_distributed: This deal was not distributed by the widget

adv.rules_hint: Checked top to bottom; the first match assigns the manager
adv.sla_enable: Reassign if the manager doesn't pick up the deal
